provided.title: File:Lascar Nairobi's skyline from Uhuru Park (4519272483).jpg

observed.caption: Wide view of a dry park with scattered trees and covered stands in the foreground and a dense city skyline under a clear blue sky in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows an expansive outdoor park viewed from an elevated position. In the immediate foreground is dry, patchy ground with reddish soil and several small trees with sparse green and yellow foliage casting shadows. Behind that are long, low covered grandstands with zigzag roofs and tiered seating. Beyond the stands is a green park area with dense trees, open grassy patches, and a small pond reflecting the sky. In the far background a dense cluster of high-rise buildings and skyscrapers of varying heights and shapes forms a city skyline under a bright, clear blue sky with strong daylight illumination.
